function.name: add_todo
function.description: Adds a new todo item to the todo.csv file with auto-generated ID, timestamp, and pending status.

todo_text.description: The text content of the todo item to be added.

path.description: The file path to the todo.csv file. If not provided, the default path will be used.

function.name: delete_todo
function.description: Deletes a todo item from a specified CSV file (defaulting to the primary todo.csv) by its unique ID.

todo_id.description: The unique integer ID of the todo item to delete.

path.description: Optional path to the todo CSV file. Defaults to the primary todo.csv file.

function.name: delete_todo_column
function.description: Removes a specified column from the todo CSV file.

column_name.description: The name of the column to be removed from the todo CSV file.

path.description: Optional file path to the todo CSV file; if not provided, the default path is used.

function.name: add_table_row
function.description: Appends a new row of dummy (placeholder) data to the specified CSV table. If specific column values are provided, uses them; otherwise generates sensible dummy data.

table_identifier.description: The identifier or name of the CSV table file to append a row to.

column_values.description: Optional mapping of column names to values for the new row.

path.description: Optional file path or directory containing the CSV table.

function.name: add_table_row
function.description: Appends a new row of dummy (placeholder) data to the specified CSV table. If specific column values are provided, uses them; otherwise generates sensible dummy data.

table_identifier.description: The file path or identifier of the CSV table to which the row will be appended.

column_values.description: Optional mapping of column names to values to override the generated dummy data for the new row.

path.description: Optional file system path to the CSV table file. Overrides table_identifier if provided.

function.name: add_multiple_rows
function.description: Appends the specified column values as new rows to the given CSV table a specified number of times.

table_identifier.description: The identifier or filename of the CSV table file.

column_values.description: Mapping of column names to their respective values for the new rows.

times.description: The number of times to append the new rows.

path.description: Optional file path to the CSV table; if provided, this overrides table_identifier.

function.name: add_multiple_rows
function.description: Appends the specified column values as new rows to the given CSV table a specified number of times.

table_identifier.description: The identifier or filename of the CSV table file.

column_values.description: Mapping of column names to their respective values for the new rows.

times.description: The number of times to append the new rows.

path.description: Optional file path to the CSV table; if provided, this overrides table_identifier.
